map.线速度与半径之比即角速度。: Angular velocity is the ratio of linear velocity to radius.
map.由线速度与半径求角速度。: Find angular velocity from linear velocity and radius.
map.在线速度与角速度之间双向换算。: Bidirectional conversion between linear and angular velocity.
map.ω = 10/2 = 5 rad/s。即线速 10 m/s、半径 2 m 时角速: ω = 10/2 = 5 rad/s. That is, angular velocity 5 rad/s when linear speed 10 m/s and radius 2 m.
map.ω=v/r=18/3=6.000 rad/s；换算成转速为 ω×60/(2π)=: ω=v/r=18/3=6.000 rad/s; converted to rpm is ω×60/(2π)=57.296 rpm. The larger the radius, the lower the angular velocity for the same linear speed.
map.rpm 怎么转 rad/s？: How to convert rpm to rad/s?
map.这三个单位怎么互相验证？: How do these three units verify each other?
map.核心关系是 v=ω·r：知道任意两个就能求第三个。换算转速时注意 ω 的单位必须: The core relation is v=ω·r: knowing any two gives the third. When converting rpm note that ω must be in rad/s; one turn is 2π radians, so rpm=ω×60/(2π) (multiply by 60 to change "per second" to "per minute").
